statement: Find all triples $(a, b, c)$ of real numbers with $ab + bc + ca = 1$ and $a^2b + c = b^2c + a = c^2a + b$.
Dominoes are placed on a $2n \times 2n$ board so every cell is adjacent to exactly one cell covered by a domino. For each $n$, find the largest number of dominoes that can be placed.

In $\triangle ABC$ with $\angle CAB > \angle ABC$ and incenter $I$, let $D \in BC$ with $\angle CAD = \angle ABC$. Let $\omega$ be the circle tangent to $AC$ at $A$ and passing through $I$; $X$ the second intersection of $\omega$ with the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$. Prove the angle bisectors of $\angle DAB$ and $\angle CXB$ meet on $BC$.

In $\triangle ABC$ with incenter $I$, the circle through $B$ tangent to $AI$ at $I$ meets $AB$ again at $P$; the circle through $C$ tangent to $AI$ at $I$ meets $AC$ again at $Q$. Prove $PQ$ is tangent to the incircle of $\triangle ABC$.

Let $n \geq 2$ and $a_1, \ldots, a_n$ be positive integers. Show there exist positive integers $b_1, \ldots, b_n$ with: (A) $a_i \leq b_i$; (B) $b_1, \ldots, b_n$ have pairwise distinct remainders mod $n$; (C) $\displaystyle\sum b_i \leq \tfrac{n-1}{2} + n\left\lfloor\frac{\sum a_i}{n}\right\rfloor + n$.

Alina draws 2019 chords on a circle with distinct endpoints. A point is \textit{marked} if it is an endpoint or an intersection of $\geq 2$ chords. She labels 2019 endpoints with 0 and 2019 with 1; intersections get arbitrary integers. Each segment between consecutive marked points on a chord gets a yellow label (sum of endpoint labels) and a blue label (absolute difference). The $N+1$ yellow labels are $0, 1, \ldots, N$ each exactly once. Prove at least one blue label is divisible by 3.
